| check | reading |
|---|---|
| scope | 24 files, +438/−25: `plugin-map/ObjectMap.tsx`, a new `HostMapStyleProvider` / `useHostMapStyle` in `@object-ui/react` (beside `HostNavigationContext`), `app-shell` `runtime-config.ts` (`mapStyleUrl?`) and `ConsoleShell.tsx` (the injection), one new key `element.map.styleFailedDeployment` in all ten packs, README + docs page, three sources records (i18n, plugin-map, react), root `.changeset/` |
| order | the view's own `mapStyle` / `map.style` → runtime-config `mapStyleUrl` → `DEFAULT_MAP_STYLE`; the failure notice names the style that actually failed |
| seam | a context in `@object-ui/react`: a prop cannot reach a `ComponentRegistry` renderer, and a provider exported from `plugin-map` would pull maplibre-gl into every page through `registerLazy`. `plugin-map` stays off `app-shell`, its exports unchanged. Accepted |
| deviation | `react.json` and one i18n key beyond the claim's surface: needed by the seam and by a notice that would otherwise blame the demo tiles. Accepted |
| red first / ablation | `ObjectMap.tsx` reverted: 3 red (both operator-style cases and the deployment notice); injected value set to `undefined`: the ConsoleShell supply pin red |
| tests | 149 files / 1862 tests green after the main merge; type-check 0 errors in plugin-map, react, i18n, app-shell |
| gates | 45 derived, 44 run exit 0; `check:type-check-debt` NOT MEASURED locally (lock) |
| governance | NOT governed, 463 lines |

**Open question:** the spec's `mapStyle` row wording ("overriding the public demo tiles") stays as it is; the spec is outside this card.

**Not armed yet:** the PR is `dirty`, and it is on the i18n line behind #26055. Once #26055 has MERGED it gets a patch round (merge main, take main's records, re-record i18n / plugin-map / react under the lock, `check-sdui-manifest`, Console build), then lands.

## 维护者速读
改了什么：地图视图没有自带样式时，先画部署级默认地图样式（运营设置的 OS_CONSOLE_MAP_STYLE_URL，经 runtime-config 的 mapStyleUrl 下发），没有再退回公共演示瓦片；该样式加载失败时，提示语点名“本部署的默认样式”，不再误指公共瓦片。
为什么改：服务端已下发 mapStyleUrl，但前端从不读取，运营配置了默认样式也不生效，所有未设样式的地图仍画限流、无可用性保证的演示瓦片(#26163)。
风险与回滚：只在部署设置了该变量且视图未自带样式时改变所见，视图自带样式照旧优先；无 spec 键、无数据改动；回滚即撤销本 PR，地图回到演示瓦片。
先看:`ui/packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx`(样式取值顺序 mapStyleOwner / drawnMapStyle 与失败提示三分支)→ `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ConsoleShell.tsx`(HostMapStyleProvider 挂载点)→ `ui/packages/react/src/context/HostMapStyleContext.tsx`。
两分钟验证：在 `ui/` 下运行 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.deploymentStyle-26163.test.tsx`,预期全部通过(设了部署样式画部署样式、未设画演示瓦片、视图样式优先、失败提示点名部署样式)。
需要你做的：无，席位落地。
席位意见:ACCEPT。行为与此前席位 ACCEPT 相同;此后三轮只合 main、重录 i18n/react 记录;CI 全绿。PR 正文里「Local verification at head `3f5e3446`」一节已过时，以本核对为准。
